title: Hand off Xcode selections with file and line context to coding agents
summary: Serg Dort demonstrates selecting Swift code in Xcode, adding a review note, and pasting the file path, exact selection coordinates, code, and message into Claude Code. His accompanying thread explains why he reviews agent changes in the IDE; an iOS team can use the same explicit context handoff while navigating surrounding code and inspecting diffs.
takeaway: Review agent changes in Xcode and send the exact file, selection range, code, and review note together, rather than relying on approximate line references.
